text: Holidays need one setting, or online booking will offer families a day we're closed.
The one thing to remember: add every holiday as a closed day, or online booking will offer it.
A closed day stops online booking. Staff can still book by hand if we need to.

Do the same for Christmas and New Year's Day. Then check each doctor's calendar for visits already booked on those days.

The most common mistakes: forgetting a holiday until a family books it, and assuming a doctor's day off closes the practice. It only closes that doctor's calendar. Remember: add every holiday as a closed day. Do Thanksgiving, Christmas and New Year's Day now.
